The display shows the measurements in cubic meter volume and cubic meter per hour flow rate. The meter is not designed to measure reverse flow. The meter does not require any extra-mechanical housing or adjustments. The meter is intended for mount to the connecting horizontal, vertical and diagonal pipework with the flow axis in the horizontal, vertical and diagonal plane and with the indicating device positioned at the top and at the side.
